execution.timing_policy: uncontrolled diagnostics only; concurrent GPU load forbids benchmark claims

sampling.algorithm: accepted shifted-Halton with deterministic boundary challenges

geometry.pitch_binary64_policy: move inward by at most 64 ULPs until geometry v1.1 pitch identity passes
geometry.exit_binary64_policy: move exit radius inward by at most 128 ULPs until taper continuity passes

preview.description: geometry v1.1 thin-volume current-equivalent preview; not material-aware

qoi_policy.fixed_locations: nearest grid nodes at axis/chamber midpoint, axis/injector exit, axis/exit start and chamber-radius/chamber midpoint
qoi_policy.mirror_ratio: per adjacent stages: larger absolute stage-centre axis Bz divided by max(abs gap-midpoint Bz, accepted topology tolerance)
qoi_policy.stage_gradient: centred axis-Bz finite difference at each stage centre
qoi_policy.boundary_ratio: maximum sampled non-axis outer-boundary magnitude divided by global sampled peak
qoi_policy.field_energy: axisymmetric trapezoidal integral of B squared over two mu0
qoi_policy.source_error: maximum relative area error, relative ampere-turn error and centroid error divided by minimum band thickness
qoi_policy.topology_claim: sampled-axis descriptor; not a continuous critical-point proof

representative_policy.tie_break: lexicographically smallest case_id after exact objective extremum
representative_policy.coalescence: roles may select the same case; archive unique selected cases only; never pad

replay_contract.identity_policy: sampling, geometry, source and config hashes must match bitwise
replay_contract.cuda_policy: CUDA floating outputs are compared numerically and are never required or claimed bitwise-identical
replay_contract.artifact_policy: artifact hashes identify this run only

failure_taxonomy.CASE_PREPARATION_FAILURE: sampling, geometry, preview or source contract failure
failure_taxonomy.ARTIFACT_FAILURE: strict accepted L1a artifact construction or validation failure
failure_taxonomy.PARITY_FAILURE: independent CPU parity solve or comparison failure

claim_limits: No thrust, efficiency, Isp, plasma, thermal or structural quantity is calculated.
Equivalent current bands are non-authoritative and not a permanent-magnet material model.
Results are L1a screening evidence only and are not hardware-valid or build-qualified.
